name: Anna Leopoldovna
contribution: Regent of Russia for just over a year during the minority of her infant son Emperor Ivan VI.
legacy: After Biron threatened to exile this person and her spouse to Germany, she had little difficulty working with Field Marshal Burkhard Christoph von Münnich to overthrow him.

checks.lead: Anna Leopoldovna (Russian: А́нна Леопо́льдовна; 18 December 1718 – 19 March 1746), born Elisabeth Katharina Christine von Mecklenburg-Schwerin and also known as Anna Carlovna (А́нна Ка́рловна), was regent of Russia for just over a year (1740–1741) during the minority of her infant son Emperor Ivan VI.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
